title: remove cli_main
description:
It's unneeded now that the application manifest correctly forces
Windows to use UTF-8 as the activeCodePage[1] and the installer forces
a new enough (i.e., still supported by Microsoft) Windows[2].

We have some tests that fail without the application manifest change
or on Windows too old to recognize the application manifest. Add a
couple more.

[1] - 8c50fce8adb8bdcc8fc82de0dea9843b278f952a
[2] - 04dbbce5b454a307b37cef768d4bf0cddbfea35b
